comments.author: dzole0311
comments.body:
Introduced this as a constant to centralize which fields are shown per layer and renderer in the Layer modal.

Most fields are currently left as-is since I'm not 100% clear on their relationships to other parts of MMGIS. But we can refine and iterate on this as those interactions become clearer.
